page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5ge.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The instance features 24 dedicated vCPUs and 144.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor.
This server includes 3839 GB of bundled local SSD storage. The network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU hardware.

The hardware profile offers a high density of local SSD storage relative to the compute resources, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high-capacity local storage without the overhead of external block storage. Appropriate workloads include databases, storage-intensive applications, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and high network throughput.
